name: sawbuck
description: Sawbuck for Claude Code: re-prove each win from source edits, in one install.

plugins.name: sawbuck-reins
plugins.description: One install wires the sawbuck guide band (watching / N caught / last verdict / steer rate) plus six slash commands: /sawbuck-reins:contract (one step: sign the repo and start watching), /sawbuck-reins:check (verify now), /sawbuck-reins:watch (arm the Stop hook), /sawbuck-reins:context (ranked history), /sawbuck-reins:debt (live suppression debt), /sawbuck-reins:status (the inventory). The mod runs no program; the commands run the pinned sawbuck CLI through Claude's own Bash tool.
